item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00380","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C10","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a direct and material drafting template. The child expressly identifies C02's June 13, 1956 proclamation as the instrument carrying out the Sixth Protocol, then reproduces its distinctive framework for the Eighth Protocol: recitals establishing the original GATT agreement, findings and consultations, execution and effective date of a supplementary-concessions protocol, separate treatment of Schedule XX Parts I and II for general and Cuban concessions, staged column rates, and an exception for more favorable customs treatment. C10 and C21 contain earlier versions of much of this machinery, but C02 is substantially closer in language, organization, subject, and temporal proximity.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I entered... into a trade agreement... consist[ing] of the Eighth Protocol of Supplementary Concessions... including...
